title: The week in pictures: May Day marches, King Charles in Bermuda and Mali's rebel push
summary: Workers across the world marched against the rising cost of living, King Charles III became the first reigning British king to visit the territory of Bermuda and Mali mourned the killing of defence minister Sadio Camara as a joint jihadist-separatist offensive shook the state. FRANCE 24 looks back at some of the week's most striking images.
